With current assets exceeding current liabilities by a strong margin (current ratio ≈ 3.4), the issuer shows good near-term liquidity. Profitability is positive (net margin ≈ 7% and EBIT margin ≈ 13.5%), and leverage appears moderate with total liabilities roughly comparable to shareholders’ equity (liabilities-to-equity ≈ 1.04). Overall, this supports a mid–investment-grade profile but not the stronger margins/leverage headroom typical of higher ratings.

DECISION: BBB+
